cases.title: Each route serves only its scope
cases.when: The same caller lists tools at /mcp, /mcp/agent/{agent}, /mcp/agent-group/{group} and /mcp/agent-group/{group}/{agent}
then: agent route: only when the caller is the agent or holds a delegation in chain
group route: only tools permitted through that group, caller an enabled member

cases.title: A mismatch looks the same whether or not the target exists
cases.when: A caller requests an agent and a group that exist but are not theirs, and ones that do not exist
then: No catalog and no fallback to /mcp

cases.title: tools/call re-checks scope and authorization
cases.when: A tool is listed, then the caller is removed from the group, then tools/call is sent

cases.title: The URL never changes who the caller is
cases.when: Agent A calls /mcp/agent/b without a delegation

cases.title: ?toolset= filters visibility only
cases.when: tools/list with ?toolset=x, then tools/call of a permitted tool outside x
then: The call is still authorized by policy alone

cases.title: Route slugs follow the grammar
cases.when: Slugs with uppercase, a leading hyphen, 64 characters and path traversal are requested
then: All get the same 403 as a non-existent scope

cases.title: The decision cache is keyed by scope and epochs
cases.when: The same identity calls through two scopes, then the authorization epoch bumps
then: No decision is reused across scopes or epochs

cases.title: RFC 9728 metadata is served without auth
then: 200 naming the tenant's trusted issuers for this resource
A 401 elsewhere points at it in WWW-Authenticate
